messages.content: Help me update the data in a spreadsheet view within a database application, ensuring that metadata is refreshed, existing data is appended, and the current state is preserved?

function.name: SpreadsheetPresentation_refreshData
function.description: Refreshes the data in the spreadsheet view, with options to refresh metadata, append data, and keep the current state. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

refreshMetadata.description: Indicates whether to refresh the metadata. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

append.description: Indicates whether to append the data to the existing data. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

keepState.description: Indicates whether to preserve the current state of the spreadsheet. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.
